title: Thorny Devil Ka Paani Peene Ka Ajab Sach! 🦎 #shorts
idea: The Thorny Devil lizard can absorb water directly through its skin and microscopic channels using capillary action.

lines.text: Kya koi jaanwar bina munh khole apni twacha se paani peeta hai?
Ye hai Thorny Devil jo 21 cm lamba ek anokha chhapat chipkali hai!
Iske sharir par bane microscopic channels paani ko sidhe munh tak kheenchate hain!
Bas gili ret par khade hone se ye paani peena shuru kar deta hai!
Aur ye ek din mein hazaron cheentiyon ko aaram se kha jaata hai!
Kya aapne pehle kabhi twacha se paani peene wala jaanwar dekha tha?

youtube.title: Thorny Devil Ka Paani Peene Ka Ajab Sach! 🦎 #shorts
youtube.description:
Jaaniye kaise Australia ka Thorny Devil bina munh khol kar apni skin se paani peeta hai! Is anokhe jaanwar ki skin capillary action se paani munh tak pahunchati hai. 

#ThornyDevil #MindBlowingFacts #HinglishFacts #WildLifeFacts #Shorts

facts.claim: The thorny devil grows up to 21 cm in total length.
Capillary action transports water to the mouth through channels in its skin.
Thorny devils eat thousands of ants in one day.
